{{Quote|Call me Grunta. It'd be my pleasure to take you where you need to go. ''Friend''.|Grunta, to Han Solo|<ref name="Target" />}}
'''Grunta''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] who lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Grunta encountered the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[X-7|Tobin Elad]] on the outskirts of Pilaan.

As the Rebels were trying to find a way to meet with the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Nal Kenuun]], Grunta offered to arrange a meeting with Kenuun, whom he worked for as a podracer, in exchange for one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Instead, the Rebels were led into an ambush by four Dug companions of Grunta armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and riding [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]]. During the brief fight, Solo blasted one of the swoops' starboard [[Engine/Legends|engines]], and it crashed on Grunta, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him instantly.

==Biography==
===Early life===
{{Quote|Getting into trouble was one of Grunta's few talents. It's the reason I had him shadowed by a homing droid.|Nal Kenuun|<ref name="Target" />}}
[[File:Muunilinst.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Grunta resided on Muunilinst.]]
Grunta was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] who resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Pilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. He worked as a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] under the employ of [[Nal Kenuun]], a feared [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gambling/Legends|gambler]].<ref name="Target" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NERC" /> a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Grunta met the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[X-7]], the latter of whom the Rebels were unaware was actually an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] secretly using the alias Tobin Elad.<ref name="Target" />

Inside a [[Unidentified Muunilinst cantina|cantina]] located outside Pilaan, the Rebels attempted to find information on how to contact Kenuun, but they were unsuccessful as the locals refused to cooperate. Grunta approached the Rebels and offered to arrange a high-stakes game&mdash;with a ten thousand&ndash;[[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] buy-in&mdash;with Kenuun in return for a hundred-credit fee. Solo agreed to the proposition, and the Rebels followed Grunta deep to the city's outskirts.<ref name="Target" />

===Ambushing the Rebels===
{{Quote|All we want is the money! Give us that and you're free to go.|Grunta to Han Solo|<ref name="Target" />}}
[[File:HanChillinAtChalmuns-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Han Solo, who was responsible for Grunta's death]]
Instead of a high-stakes game, the Rebels were led by Grunta into an ambush by four of his fellow Dugs flying [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] and armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Grunta demanded that they hand over all of their credits, and the Rebels decided to fight back. After a short skirmish, the Dugs chose to retreat as one of them was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Solo, who shot the starboard [[Engine/Legends|engine]] of the pilot's swoop, crashing it with a [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] explosion. Grunta, who was wrestled into the ground by Chewbacca, was also among those who perished in the brief melee when the swoop's remains crashed into him.<ref name="Target" />

After the ambush, the Rebels were captured by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] working for Kenuun, who, upon meeting them in his [[Nal Kenuun's apartment|home]], revealed he had a [[homing droid]] shadow Grunta as a precaution due to his penchant for trouble, enabling Kenuun's stormtroopers to capture the Rebels. Kenuun offered the Rebels a deal in which one of them would take Grunta's place in an upcoming [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] event in exchange for a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] that Kenuun had taken from [[Mak Luunim]], a Rebel Alliance contact on the planet. The datacard contained a set of secret financial accounts that the Rebellion desperately needed, as most of their funds had been lost after the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]]. As retrieving the datacard was their mission in the first place, Skywalker agreed to take Grunta's spot.<ref name="Target" />

With Grunta's death, all of Kenuun's fellow Muuns who were competing against him were overjoyed at the news. One Muun in particular, [[Chenik Kruun]], was known to be cold-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] and emotionless yet, according to Beeerd, Kruun almost smiled when he heard of Grunta's demise, delighted at the prospect of finally being able to beat Kenuun in a race. When Han Solo admitted to having a part in Grunta's death, a crowd of [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracing]] pilots and crewmen gathered inside a large tent near the racetrack, where they passed [[Time/Legends|time]] before the race, and cheered the news. [[Haari Ikreme Beeerd]], who was a crewman for [[Gilag Pitaaani|another podracer]], even befriended Solo and treated the crowd to another round of drinks.<ref name="Target" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|I'm guessing Grunta wasn't a friend of yours?''"<br />"''That piece of bantha slime? Haari Ikreme Beeerd, at your service. Any enemy of Grunta is a friend to us all.|Han Solo and Haari Ikreme Beeerd|<ref name="Target" />}}
Grunta was short and scaly and was barely a [[Meter/Legends|meter]] tall, which was shorter than most Dugs. Nal Kenuun described Grunta as someone possessing a talent for trouble, which was why he had a homing [[Droid/Legends|droid]] keeping track of the Dug. When he was not racing, Grunta engaged in the armed robbery of individuals with the help of his Dug companions.<ref name="Target" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grunta was a character created by author [[Alex Wheeler]] for the [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Target]]'', the first volume in the [[Star Wars: Rebel Force|''Rebel Force'']] series.<ref name="Target" />
